description:
G-Link connects your Fedora/GNOME desktop with the G-Link Android app: fast local device discovery, quick file transfer, notifications, clipboard sync, SMS, remote input, and view-only screen sharing through GNOME Remote Desktop.

G-Link is a fork of GSConnect (itself built on the KDE Connect protocol). Source and issues: https://github.com/serious-capybara/g-link-extension
name: G-Link
